title: Wave 4 Source Reliability Memory Arbitration

agents.persona: A resident executing a private urban intention.
agents.private_intention: Recall both the verified notice and the later unverified message, apply the arbitration rule, and complete a 10-minute free study session at the location named by the reliable source. The more recent unreliable source must not be followed.
memory_seeds: Verified notice (source: city service bulletin, tagged reliable): the quiet study room is at spc_library today.
Later chat message (source: unverified group thread, tagged unreliable): someone said the study room moved to spc_office.
Arbitration rule: when two recalled sources conflict, follow the source tagged reliable, even if the unreliable one is more recent.

public_context: Only environment-observable action evidence counts as completion.

architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May narrate success without the required action evidence.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Must preserve the intention while updating the plan.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Must use relevant private memory without goal drift.

benchmark_metadata.mechanism_parameter: two recalled memories conflict and the decision must follow the source tagged as reliable under the current cue

mechanism_contract.state_transition: two recalled memories conflict and the decision must follow the source tagged as reliable under the current cue
mechanism_contract.negative_failure: follow the newer but explicitly unreliable memory

novelty_against.wave3: not recency-based trigger and fallback recall
